description.value: Trout Lake Community Centre is a City of Vancouver civic facility serving the Commercial Drive neighbourhood, situated alongside John Hendry Park and Trout Lake itself. Operated by Vancouver Parks, Recreation and Culture, it functions as both a community centre and sports facility with programming for all ages. The surrounding park and lake make it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring East Vancouver's recreational corridors.
